caption: The info panel's order line now gives a selected unit's destination as a distance and compass point instead of raw world-unit coordinates. A lone Archers regiment, selected so its panel stays open, is sent about 15 m up and to the right. After a brief "Re-forming" hold the order line reads "Moving 15 m north-east" and counts down as the block marches, until the unit arrives, goes idle, and the line reads "Holding position". North is the top of the screen.
